newsitem.title: ZAIRE: Zaire's Archbishop Monsengwo arrives in Kinshasa.
newsitem.headline: Zaire's Archbishop Monsengwo arrives in Kinshasa.

text.p: Archbishop Laurent Monsengwo, tipped by some as a key player in any political settlement to Zaire's civil war, arrived in the capital Kinshasa on Monday, witnesses said.
Witnesses at the river port, where he arrived from Congo's capital Brazzaville, said Monsengwo was cheered by bystanders as he left with heavy security.

The archbishop was elected to his old post as speaker of Zaire's transitional parliament by supporters of ailing and embattled President Mobutu Sese Seko at the weekend. He has not yet said he will take the job.
Laurent Kabila's rebel alliance, whose troops were last reported to be 200 km (125 miles) from Kinshasa, said they would attack the city if Monsengwo accepted the position.
